dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have my reservations about that.

dialogues.speaker: Angelique
dialogues.text: Ah, so it would seem that we're opposed on this issue.

dialogues.speaker: Angelique
dialogues.text: That's alright. Aesthetics are subjective in the end, and I don't intend to persuade you. May we each be equally nourished by the bounty of this land.
